recommendation: Keep the empty no-change audit commit. No FHIR-36051 follow-up is needed in core; broader include feature modeling and wildcard include clarification should remain separate issue decisions.
issue_request: FHIR-36051 asked how a requirements CapabilityStatement should declare a recursive searchInclude when the recursive include belongs to a resource type that otherwise has no required interaction. The Published/Persuasive with Modification resolution allowed listing that include under the root resource type and noted this detail is mostly useful for conformance expectations.
initial_application: The issue was applied by commit 3b6e443e496f907801189a895636c924267804eb and merged by 137772c14c1208a817da97bc19068b3fab5d274f, adding explicit CapabilityStatement.rest.resource.searchInclude guidance and making searchRevInclude refer to it.
additional_context: CapabilityStatement is active in source/fhir.ini. Later commits updated the same comment from recursive/_include:recurse to iterative/_include:iterate and added wildcard include wording without changing the FHIR-36051 root-resource rule. Zulip and Confluence evidence match the Jira disposition.
reconciliation: No source edit was made. The current comment says iterative (a.k.a. recursive) _include support is communicated by listing the supported iterative include values in the searchInclude element of the root resource type, with the CarePlan example listing both CarePlan:activity-reference:DeviceRequest and DeviceRequest:device under CarePlan.

related_jiras.note: A broader Published issue about representing _include:iterate support in CapabilityStatement2; it explains terminology context but is not required to decide FHIR-36051.
A later wildcard include clarification edited the same comment without changing the recursive/iterative root-resource rule.
